run_gemm_benchmark: run the gemm kernel performance benchmark on cpu gpu or tpu with dataset A B or C
run_emb_benchmark: run the embedding bag kernel performance benchmark on cpu gpu or tpu with dataset A or B
run_linear_benchmark: run the linear mlp kernel performance benchmark on cpu gpu or tpu with sgd or adagrad optimizer
